app_info.subtitle: Desktop Automation Agent
app_info.description: Sovereign desktop automation & computer-use agent. Sees your screen, clicks UI elements, launches apps, and automates tasks live on your PC/Mac.

justifications.read_only_justification: Captures the screen and inspects UI elements without modifying any system state or user files.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates exclusively on the local desktop display and does not access external network domains.
justifications.destructive_justification: Takes an image capture of the screen and cannot delete, overwrite, or mutate data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Launches desktop applications which creates new processes on the operating system.
justifications.open_world_justification: Launches local desktop binaries on the host system without connecting to open world external APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Opening system processes alters operating system state and window configuration.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends physical mouse click inputs that can trigger UI actions, form submissions, or button activations.
justifications.open_world_justification: Interacts directly with UI elements on the local host display.
justifications.destructive_justification: Clicking arbitrary buttons or UI elements can trigger irreversible state changes or actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Injects keystrokes and text into active application windows which modifies document contents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Injects text locally into focused desktop windows without communicating with external services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Typing text can alter or replace file and document contents in active applications.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends system key combinations that invoke application shortcuts or operating system commands.
justifications.open_world_justification: Dispatches local OS keyboard hotkeys directly on the user machine.
justifications.destructive_justification: Hotkeys can trigger destructive application shortcuts such as close, cut, or delete.

justifications.read_only_justification: Modifies window geometry and positioning on the desktop without modifying file contents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Adjusts local window coordinates on the host monitor.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only resizes and moves windows into split screen layouts, causing no data loss.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders ambient completion visual feedback and acoustic confirmation on the glass.
justifications.open_world_justification: Renders local on-screen confirmation graphics without sending data to external endpoints.
justifications.destructive_justification: Displays a transient completion notification and plays a confirmation chime without altering files.

test_cases.description: Captures the desktop screen, inspects active window hierarchy, and returns distilled UI element coordinates.
test_cases.prompt: Take a screenshot of my desktop screen to see what is currently open.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Returns a capture of the active desktop screen along with a distilled textual hierarchy of open application windows and interactive UI control coordinates.
test_cases.user_prompt: Take a screenshot of my desktop screen to see what is currently open.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a capture of the active desktop screen along with a distilled textual hierarchy of open application windows and interactive UI control coordinates.

test_cases.description: Visibly launches a desktop application (Calculator) on the user machine in the foreground.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Calculator launches visibly in the foreground on the user's desktop with window focus confirmed.
test_cases.expected_output: Calculator launches visibly in the foreground on the user's desktop with window focus confirmed.

test_cases.description: Injects keyboard input and mathematical formulas into the active application window.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The formula "485 * 32.5 =" is typed directly into Calculator via native keyboard event injection, calculating and displaying 15762.5.
test_cases.expected_output: The formula "485 * 32.5 =" is typed directly into Calculator via native keyboard event injection, calculating and displaying 15762.5.

test_cases.description: Arranges two active application windows side-by-side in split screen layout in sub-15ms.
test_cases.prompt: Snap Calculator to the left and Notepad to the right.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reposition and resize Calculator to the left half and Notepad to the right half in a clean split-screen layout.
test_cases.user_prompt: Snap Calculator to the left and Notepad to the right.
test_cases.expected_output: Reposition and resize Calculator to the left half and Notepad to the right half in a clean split-screen layout.

test_cases.description: Marks an automation task as complete, playing confirmation feedback and returning final summary.
test_cases.prompt: Complete the desktop task and summarize the actions taken.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Displays green completion border glow, plays confirmation chime, and returns a structured summary confirming the desktop automation routine is finished.
test_cases.user_prompt: Complete the desktop task and summarize the actions taken.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays green completion border glow, plays confirmation chime, and returns a structured summary confirming the desktop automation routine is finished.

negative_test_cases.description: User asks a purely creative or conversational question unrelated to desktop control. No tools should be triggered.
negative_test_cases.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: The assistant writes the poem conversationally without triggering any desktop tools.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant writes the poem conversationally without triggering any desktop tools.

negative_test_cases.description: User asks to execute out-of-scope remote server administration or cloud commands. The plugin must safely decline.
negative_test_cases.prompt: SSH into remote server 192.168.1.100 as root and delete the database.
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: The assistant safely refuses the remote server command, clarifying that Extra Desktop Operator is exclusively for local desktop GUI automation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: SSH into remote server 192.168.1.100 as root and delete the database.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant safely refuses the remote server command, clarifying that Extra Desktop Operator is exclusively for local desktop GUI automation.

negative_test_cases.description: User asks a general knowledge factual question. No desktop automation tools should be triggered.
negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the capital of Australia and what is its time zone?
negative_test_cases.expected_behavior: The assistant answers directly that Canberra is the capital of Australia without invoking any desktop tools.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of Australia and what is its time zone?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant answers directly that Canberra is the capital of Australia without invoking any desktop tools.
